verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs give a procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden on your own Linux server. The Public API docs also reference a self-hosted instance URL (your.domain.com/api/docs/), which confirms self-hosted deployments are a supported first-party mode. Missing for 10: deployment depth in the pack (requirements, Docker/other platforms, feature parity versus cloud), and independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This article will walk you through the procedure to install and deploy Bitwarden to your own Linux server.
